decision: An optional `const` and then `end`, as KerML 8.2.4.3.1 states it.
notes:
THE CLAUSE IS FLAGGED MALFORMED AND THIS PRODUCTION IS NOT AFFECTED. The pack reports an unmatched `)` on line 8 of the Features clause. That line is inside the Feature production — its own parentheses close at -1 — and this production's parentheses balance on their own, so it is derived from the clause as written. The repair of Feature is recorded on the Feature unit.

The clause's `{ isVariable = true }` after `const` is an abstract-syntax action that sets a property; it consumes no text and is not carried into the rule.

The clause and KerML.xtext agree on what parses; the Xtext's `fragment` is not carried across.

evidence.note: the same keywords, without the isVariable action
line 11, `end [0..1] feature cart: ShoppingCart[1];` — `end` with no `const` before it
